chapter: Long Island years and Battle's estate
title: Which of his songs still earn royalties
summary: Topsy and I Don't Want to Set the World on Fire were his biggest, and Yesterday Here You Come Today and Wham still bring checks via MCA.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Well now, yes, we got led your own band. Now, you seemed, for a time, you seemed to be out of the picture a little bit, but this was when you were on Long Island.
Yeah.
: That's right. Now, of course, the two big compositions that have gotten your share of "Topsy" and "I Don't Want to Set the World on Fire." Those were your two biggest.
I believe it was, because those are two hit, number one.
: Yeah. What else now have you got, sort of bringing in -- I mean, originals for, like, Lunceford and Basie, bringing --

That brings the money up? Well, this tune (inaudible) Yesterday -- Here You Come Today" that brings in pretty good royalties now. (Inaudible) on the jukebox down there again now (inaudible) place. That's Johnny Ray.
Excuse me. Who else shares that?
James with lyrics and quite naturally, Basie's on it.
Yeah.
That's three of us on that.
Yeah, well, that would always be a good number.

And there's another that comes through a lot. "Wham" is pushing up a lot of (inaudible) royalties and I don't know where it's coming from. MCA's got that. But everytime I look now, "Wham" has got a pretty nice check.
Well, that's where it's been --
When I say pretty nice check, you know, even if it's as low as 300 or $400, that's a nice check to me on the numbers. I don't expect nothing on it. I don't expect having no money.
Where it's coming from is sort of where it's -- reissues by Lunceford and people like that, I guess.
MCA's got it, so that's who's reissuing it.
Now who's got it on MCA because Lunceford's is on Columbia. You mean the publishing?
Oh, yeah, the publishers.
Yeah.
MCA publishing.
They may be pushing it a little bit.
Yeah, they pushing all that stuff.
Yeah.
Coming in the picture now.
